name: moodify-desktop
description: Moodify — company desktop shell: pick a song, detect, read data & charts, get the repair/mixing plan. The core stays in moodify-core-package (pip); this shell orchestrates it.
author: 文川院 / Moodify 声音实验室

scripts.test: node scripts/check-contracts.js && node scripts/test-pipeline.js && node scripts/test-studio.js
scripts.pack:linux: npm run icon:linux && npm run rebuild:electron && electron-builder --linux --x64 --dir
scripts.dist:linux: npm run icon:linux && npm run rebuild:electron && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64

linux.synopsis: Moodify Studio — listening and production review for the Moodify Sound Protocol
linux.description: Moodify Studio is the Linux listening and production-review interface for the Moodify Sound Protocol. It orchestrates the pip-installed Moodify Core; it does not embed a second audio engine. The full pipeline expects an existing local Moodify runtime (Python 3.10-3.12 with Moodify Core 1.0.0-rc.1 importable, plus FFmpeg/FFprobe). This package does not install Python, Core, FFmpeg or model weights.

deb.maintainer: 文川院 / Moodify 声音实验室
